title: spec: ConnectorConnectionState answers the derived OAuth redirect URI (read-only key, name awaits the maintainer) so the Console can show it before an installer registers a client
body:
domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbacSXJQqAztgt4UMrS

Carries the spec half of #29463; #29463 keeps the server half (the connection door answering the derived URI from `connectorOAuthRedirectUri()`). Split on triage's route ruling 6585200349. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed by `domain:server#4`. No grade: triage sets it (triage named it p1, a protocol addition).

## What

`GET /api/v1/automation/connectors/:name/connection` should answer the deployment's derived OAuth redirect URI for an `authorization_code` instance, so the Console's Connect step (#28869) can show it with a copy button before the administrator registers a client with the vendor (#28702 ruling B, 6566728470). Today `ConnectorConnectionState` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`, read on `origin/main` 390bd2aed) carries `connector, organizationId, status, statusReason, scopes, expiresAt, connectedAt, connectedBy, client` and no redirect URI.

## Wanted (spec half only)

- One optional read-only key on `ConnectorConnectionState` carrying the derived redirect URI; absent for grants other than `authorization_code` and when the server has no base to derive from (never a guess).
- ⛔ The key name (proposed `redirectUri` on #29463) waits for the maintainer's approval before merge (triage 6585200349). Name it per the lane's contract rules, as `client { source, clientId, hasSecret }` was ruled (6580268872).
- Declaration: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` unless the lane reads it otherwise; contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

## Who reads it

#29463's server half answers the key from `ServiceAutomationPlugin.connectorOAuthRedirectUri()` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`); #29463 is `Blocked-by` this card. #28869 (Console) shows it.

Dedupe: `ConnectorConnectionState redirect`, `connector redirect uri connection state` (open and closed): only #29463, #28702, #28866, #28869. **New.**

Links back: #29463, #28869, #28702, #28866.
